title: Alternate-flight offers when a fare sells out
desc: When a customer's search returns a sold-out fare or the last seat in a cabin, 29% of those sessions are abandoned and the revenue goes to competitors. Surface alternate flights, nearby dates and comparable fares the moment a result comes back unavailable, with fare-display rules applied, while staying inside DOT consumer-protection and PCI guardrails at checkout.

evidence.text: ELT strategy review: recovering sold-out sessions is a top-3 digital revenue lever for FY27. Keep the customer in control of any fare change.

comments.text: Read-only fare/inventory access confirmed. OK from security.

title: One-tap checkout with saved traveler and payment
desc: Travelers re-enter passenger and payment details on every booking, and drop-off spikes on the payment step. Pre-fill saved profiles and offer a one-tap purchase to cut booking friction.

title: Ancillary bundle offers at checkout
desc: Customers miss seat, bag and priority options because they're buried after purchase. Surface a relevant, right-priced bundle inline at checkout.

title: Trip-status and itinerary redesign
desc: Trip details are fragmented across confirmation emails and the app, driving avoidable support contacts. Consolidate everything into a single, clear itinerary timeline.

title: DOT refund and travel-credit compliance view
desc: Refund and travel-credit obligations under the new DOT rule are tracked by hand across systems. Still sensing whether a consolidated compliance view is warranted.

title: Self-service rebooking during irregular ops (IROPS)
desc: When flights are delayed or cancelled, customers wait on hold and crowd airport counters, and many rebook on another carrier. Give travelers one real-time place to see impacted trips and self-rebook onto the best option, with proactive alerts the moment a disruption hits.

title: End-to-end baggage tracking visibility
desc: Checked bags lack reliable end-to-end visibility for travelers, driving mishandling claims and anxiety at the belt. Still gathering signals to size the problem.
